title: Variant Pro Racer TC-5

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Icon Variant Pro Racer TC-5 is bridges highway aerodynamic poise with high-flow off-road ventilation, bridging highway aero efficiency with rugged off-road ventilation. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing 1451g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~91 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Wind-tunnel tested visor for stability at speed.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Adventure/Dual Sport fit optimized for off-road and mixed terrain use.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Icon Variant Pro Racer TC-5: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Icon's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Variant Pro Racer TC-5 brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Icon Variant Pro Racer TC-5 represents Icon's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Icon Variant Pro Racer TC-5 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
